name: agent-platform-troubleshooting
description: >- Troubleshoots Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform issues (Agent Gateway, Registry, Identity, Policies, Model Armor, Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP)). Use when agent requests fail with 403 (especially unauthorized egress), Agent Runtime queries return 500, or gateway/IAP logs show permission errors. Don't use for general Google Cloud Identity and Access Management (IAM) debugging or network
